verdict.rationale: The GitHub README documents routing requests through the SaaS proxy with `-H 'x-proxy: auto'` (API key required). It describes a hosted pool that rotates residential and datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically, which directly delivers the story. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of proxy options (e.g. geo selection, bring-your-own proxies, rotation control), clarity on whether the self-hosted/open-source build supports this, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the rotation avoids blocks.
